headline: Airlie is invested in Seven Group Holdings, viewing its WesTrac and Coates businesses as high-quality, undervalued assets obscured by conglomerate discount and mediocre sector peers.
reasoning: Airlie views Seven Group Holdings as a quality business undervalued by the market because it falls into two commonly avoided categories: a conglomerate structure and capital-intensive cyclical sectors (mining services via WesTrac and equipment rental via Coates). The firm believes WesTrac and Coates are quality businesses that investors overlook while focused on headline issues such as the Boral takeover and the declining Seven West Media TV business. WesTrac has delivered through-the-cycle returns on invested capital of 14–30% and EBIT margins of 7–11%, and its earnings mix has shifted materially towards more predictable product support revenue over the past decade. Airlie's valuation of Seven is dominated by WesTrac and Coates rather than the more visible but weaker businesses.
quote: At Airlie, we look to invest in quality companies that we believe are undervalued by the market. Often these opportunities emerge when a great business sits within an otherwise mediocre sector, or when the market assigns an arbitrary discount to a type of business. For us, Seven Group Holdings (SVW) falls into both categories. Seven is a conglomerate of industrial businesses. Two of these businesses sit in sectors often unloved by investors for their volatile returns and capital intensity – mining services (WesTrac) and equipment rental (Coates). Furthermore, in listed equities 'conglomerate' is a dirty word. It can imply complexity, opacity and bloat, where the corporate structure of the company sits at odds with interest of the shareholders, and many investors choose to avoid conglomerates for these reasons. In our mind, WesTrac and Coates are quality businesses sitting within conglomerate structures, pushed further by being in mediocre industries, of Seven. While investors digest the highly publicised on-market takeover of Boral or lament the decline of the namesake Free To Air TV business (Seven West Media), WesTrac and Coates quietly demonstrate their quality and form the majority of our valuation of Seven.
